setup.command: sudo WIRES="v2 legacy" VARIANTS="gso= nogso=-udp-gso=false nobatch=-udp-batch=1" SIZES="128 144 160 176 192 208 224 240 256 272 288 304 320" LEGACY_SIZES="448" REPEATS=3 WINDOW=20s FIXED=16 FIXED_REPEATS=3 FIXED_WINDOW=60s MTU=65536 GSO_MAX_SEGS=1 SERVER_CPU=1 LOADGEN_CPUS=2,3 MAX_MBPS=12000 MAX_PPS=1500000 TAG= CHUNK_SECONDS=720 bench/run_b3.sh
setup.note: server pinned with taskset to one CPU; loadgen pinned to two others; points interleaved by repeat, size and system, each under the bench lock; v2 frame delivery counts only frames whose every fragment arrived (the load generator does not use FEC repair); server CPU is the process's utime+stime from /proc, which on loopback includes the softirq receive work of the packets it sends (kernel_config: no IRQ_TIME_ACCOUNTING)
